To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the viability of educational computer projects is enhanced when: (1) the goals of the projects are clearly stated; (2) the projects are based on a sound understanding of the educational and technological contexts; and (3) the projects include strategies for overcoming organizational constraints.
the success of educational computing projects depends on the ability of project participants to negotiate and cooperate to resolve technical and organizational challenges.
